items.markdown:
![40 Fun Things to Do on Koh Tao If You're Not Diving](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07282124-1672-0139-0000-9dda0c19dca9:4)
Top things to do in Koh Tao include `scuba diving, hiking viewpoints, and snorkeling pristine bays` . This compact Thai island is famous for its underwater world, scenic hilltops, and relaxed beach culture.[](https://zannavandijk.co.uk/koh-tao-travel-guide-best-things-koh-tao/) [[1]](https://zannavandijk.co.uk/koh-tao-travel-guide-best-things-koh-tao/)[[2]](https://www.timetravelturtle.com/thailand/things-to-do-on-koh-tao/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-8aQq7Z239U)[[4]](https://paulinetravels.com/7-great-things-to-do-in-koh-tao/)[[5]](https://www.travelwithpau.com/koh-tao-bucket-list/)

Water Activities

- **Scuba Diving:** Take an open water course or fun dive at world-famous sites like *Chumphon Pinnacle*, *Twins* , or the *HTMS Sattakut* shipwreck.[](https://paulinetravels.com/7-great-things-to-do-in-koh-tao/) 
- **Snorkel Tours:** Join a 5-bay boat trip to spot sea turtles and reef sharks at *Shark Bay*, *Aow Leuk* , and *Tanote Bay*.[](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DV8n-v6EyzS/) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DV8n-v6EyzS/)[[2]](https://www.getyourguide.com/surat-thani-province-l897/koh-tao-5-bay-guided-snorkeling-tour-with-photos-t1154638/)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/lomprayah/posts/join-our-one-day-snorkel-trip-to-koh-tao-koh-nangyuan-for-a-fun-filled-day-out-i/2937429486277015/)
- **Koh Nang Yuan:** Take a short boat ride to this iconic nearby triad of islets connected by sandbars for swimming and a classic viewpoint hike.[](https://www.timetravelturtle.com/thailand/things-to-do-on-koh-tao/) 

Land & Viewpoints

- **John-Suwan Viewpoint:** Hike 15 minutes up a steep, humid trail in the island's south for sweeping panoramic vistas over both coasts.
- **Love Koh Tao Viewpoint:** Sip a fresh coconut or coffee while taking in wide views of *Tanote Bay* from the east side of the island.
- **Beach Hopping:** Walk the coastal path from *Mae Haad* down to quiet stretches like *Sai Nuan Beach* and *Freedom Beach*.[](https://www.timetravelturtle.com/thailand/things-to-do-on-koh-tao/) [[1]](https://www.tiktok.com/@islandlifewithclaudia/video/7497916724105219350)[[2]](https://www.traveltomtom.net/destinations/asia/thailand/things-to-do-in-koh-tao)

Food & Nightlife

- **Sunset Drinks:** Watch the sun go down with a cocktail from beach bars on *Sairee Beach* or perched cliffside at the *Secret Bar*.
- **Local Dining:** Try fresh seafood at *Barracuda* or casual healthy plates at *Coconut Monkey*.
- **Thai Massage:** Relax tired muscles with a traditional one-hour foot or body massage along the main strips.[](https://www.travelwithpau.com/koh-tao-bucket-list/) [[1]](https://www.travelwithpau.com/koh-tao-bucket-list/)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVJE0U-jK2C/)[[3]](https://feelfreetravel.com/blog/thailand/things-to-do-in-krabi/)
